summary: feat(interfere): add Prometheus /metrics export for Grafana monitoring
expected_findings_themes: content negotiation on /metrics changes default behaviour for clients that don't set Accept header — document migration
instrument cardinality (per-user labels) must be bounded or Prometheus storage explodes
quality composite gauge is a derived signal that can mask its inputs — expose the components too
/metrics/prometheus and /metrics dispatching from the same handler increases the test surface
rationale: Observability surface change. fd-architecture for the dual-endpoint pattern, fd-correctness for content negotiation edge cases, fd-performance for instrument-cardinality cost, fd-user-product for the dashboard consumer story.
labeler_notes: Standard observability work — both backends should pull architecture+correctness+perf.
